description: This file defines a JavaScript module that provides a client interface to a backend chess game API. It includes functions for creating, joining, leaving, and interacting with games via REST API endpoints, with features like fetching game state, submitting moves, sending chat messages, and making offers. The module handles network considerations and fallback logic to ensure graceful degradation.

methods.name: createApiClient()
methods.description: Creates a REST API client with methods to interact with a chess game backend, including listing, creating, joining, leaving games, and other game actions.

methods.name: safeFetch(path, options)
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with network enabled checks and fallback response if network is disabled or base URL is missing.

methods.name: safeJson(res)
methods.description: Parses the JSON response safely, returning null if parsing fails.
